description: Get one price list by id with a page of its fixed prices (entries, oldest first, at most 200 per page; pass nextCursor back as after for the next page, null on the last). An entry is a fixed unit price in minor units for one product (variantKey null) or one variant of a product with variants, with its own volume breaks (tiers), its order bounds (minQuantity / maxQuantity, null = none) and its currency (an additional currency's row names it; a default-currency row reads the product's currency); recordMissing true means the product or variant was removed and the entry prices nothing - remove it with remove_price_list_entries. Filter by recordId to see one product's entries. Read-only.

currency.description: The currency whose rows to page; omit for the default currency's rows. overrideCountByCurrency names the currencies the list holds rows in

recordId.description: Only the fixed prices for this product record

name: get_price_list
title: Get price list
